Twinsity Releases Its Biggest Platform Update: Inspect Faster, Find Problems Earlier, Prove Nothing Was Missed

2026-08-04 Geo Week News Twinsity, structural inspection, digital twin, drone survey, 3D model, AI-assisted review, observation profiles, inspection report, asset management
Read the source article

Quick summary

Twinsity, a structural inspection platform based in Kassel, Germany, has released its largest update ever — rebuilding the interface around inspection workflows with an AI-assisted observation system and customizable Observation Profile Builder that lets teams replicate existing standards.

Key takeaways

  • Twinsity's largest release since founding rebuilds the interface around how inspection teams actually work, reducing clicks from model to finished report
  • The new Observation Profile Builder lets teams replicate their existing inspection standards and fields inside the platform rather than adapting to the software
  • AI surfaces potential observations for an inspector to review and confirm — the AI detects, the inspector decides, and every image is reviewed
  • The platform serves three groups: drone service providers, engineering/consulting firms, and asset owners/managers maintaining a single trusted record
  • The update arrives automatically for existing customers with data, workflows, and integrations unchanged
